descriptionByLocale.it:
Impiegato in logistica di magazzino 100% — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Losone (TI).

Impiegato in logistica di magazzino Le tue responsabilità
* Gestire la merce in entrata e in uscita dal magazzino, registrando correttamente ogni movimento nel sistema
gestionale. * Verificare bolle, codici e documenti di trasporto, garantendo conformità alle procedure e agli standard
qualitativi. * Organizzare e presidiare l'area di magazzino, assicurando ordine, corretta conservazione della merce e
controllo delle operazioni di stoccaggio. * Effettuare il rifornimento delle linee produttive e preparare la
documentazione necessaria alla movimentazione dei materiali. * Eseguire operazioni di carico e scarico merci con
carrelli elevatori e partecipare alle attività di inventario periodico.
Il tuo profilo
* Formazione come Impiegato/a in Logistica (AFC) o titolo equivalente, con almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ambito
magazzino. * Buona conoscenza dei processi logistici, del pacchetto Microsoft Office e basi SAP. * Patentino per
carrelli elevatori (frontale, retrattile, timone, trasversale) e patente B. * Precisione, affidabilità, autonomia. *
Attitudine al lavoro in team e disponibilità al lavoro su turni.
Su di noi AGIE CHARMILLES, inventore della tecnologia EDM (elettroerosione), è riconosciuto come marchio di eccellenza

• Your tasks * Ensure quality control of PCBA production processes (THT, wave soldering, selective soldering, mixed technology) and maintain control plans and acceptance criteria. * Support production teams in troubleshooting electronic failures and lead structured problem-solving activities (8D, 5 Why, root cause analysis). * Ensure reliability of electronic test systems (SPEA, Flying Probe, functional test benches) and implement corrective actions on test failures. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce internal defects and support New Product Introduction (NPI) with robust manufacturing and test processes. * Support supplier quality activities, define incoming inspection requirements, and contribute to the analysis of assemblies returned from the field.
• Your profile * Degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical background; 3--5 years of experience in electronics manufacturing, quality, or test engineering. * Knowledge of PCB assembly technologies, soldering processes, and solder joint quality; experience with electronic test systems (SPEA, Flying Probe, ICT or similar) is a strong advantage. * Structured problem-solving mindset (8D, 5 Why) with hands-on, pragmatic approach and strong technical curiosity. * Ability to work cross-functionally with production, R\&D, and supplier teams; clear and effective communication with technical stakeholders. * Fluent in Italian; English B2 or higher required. About us AGIE CHARMILLES, inventor of EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), is known as a premium brand and innovation leader in wire, die-sinking, and hole-drilling EDM. Its automation-ready solutions are used in mold making and the production of high-end components, offering Swiss precision, reliability, and performance. UNITED MACHINING is one of the world's leading providers of complete solutions for precision components and tools manufacturers and the mold-making industry. The portfolio includes milling, EDM, laser texturing, laser micromachining, and additive manufacturing machines. Additionally, the division offers spindles, automation, tooling, and digitalized solutions backed by unrivaled customer services and support. UNITED MACHINING includes the brands AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC and SYSTEM 3R. UNITED MACHINING is headquartered in Biel, Switzerland, and currently has over 3'000 employees on over 50 sites worldwide. HR Specialist 100% — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Losone (TI).

HR Specialist Your tasks
* Support the HRBP in managing employees and managers throughout the entire employee lifecycle, from onboarding to
offboarding. * Independently manage HR processes such as employment contracts, contract amendments, absences, returns
to work, transfers and terminations. * Provide first-level HR advice to employees and managers on employment
conditions, internal regulations, absences and contractual matters. * Prepare contracts, employment letters,
certificates and other HR documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal and legal requirements. *
Contribute to HR projects and process improvements, supporting the development of efficient tools, procedures and HR
services.
Your profile
* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Psychology, Sociology or a related field. * An HR Specialist certification, such as
the Swiss Federal Professional Certificate in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification, is considered a strong
advantage. * Previous experience in an HR Specialist, HR Generalist or comparable role, with exposure to the main HR
processes. * Good understanding of the employee lifecycle and the ability to manage HR cases with a high degree of
accuracy and autonomy. * Strong interpersonal skills, discretion, organisational ability and a service-oriented
approach. * Fluent in Italian and good command in English.
About us AGIE CHARMILLES, inventor of EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), is known as a premium brand and innovation
leader in wire, die-sinking, and hole-drilling EDM. Its automation-ready solutions are used in mold making and the
production of high-end components, offering Swiss precision, reliability, and performance. UNITED MACHINING is one of
the world's leading providers of complete solutions for precision components and tools manufacturers and the
mold-making industry. The portfolio includes milling, EDM, laser texturing, laser micromachining, and additive
manufacturing machines. Additionally, the division offers spindles, automation, tooling, and digitalized solutions
backed by unrivaled customer services and support. UNITED MACHINING includes the brands AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES,
MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC and SYSTEM 3R. UNITED MACHINING is headquartered in Biel, Switzerland, and currently has
over 3'000 employees on over 50 sites worldwide. Your contact Ivana Karlovic HR Business Partner +41 91 806 90 84

## Ihre Aufgaben
- Reparaturen und Störungsbehebungen von Maschinenproblemen (Mechanik / Elektrik / Steuerung) weltweit vor Ort bei unseren Kunden
- Umsetzung von Modifikationen, Umbauten und Software Upgrades
- Durchführung von Wartungsarbeiten
- Mithilfe bei Maschinen-Neumontagen
## Ihr Profil
- Mechanische oder elektrische Grundausbildung (z.B. in Automatik, Polymechanik)
- Mechanik-, Elektro-, Hydraulik- und Pneumatik-Kenntnisse
- Idealerweise Kundendiensterfahrung in Servicetechnik oder Montage
- Kenntnisse zu CNC-Steuerungen von Vorteil (Siemens oder Heidenhain)
- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (mündlich und schriftlich)
- Reisebereitschaft weltweit bis ca. 80%
- ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von 5-Achs-Fräslösungen für die Luft- und Raumfahrt- sowie die Energieerzeugungsindustrie. Mit einer starken Kundenorientierung liefert sowohl standardisierte als auch massgeschneiderte Lösungen, die auf spezifische Produktionsanforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

- Ausgezeichnete Karrierechancen: UNITED MACHINING bietet viele Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung. Wir bieten einen Talentmanagementprozess (MyNextBigStep), um Ihre Karriere zu fördern.
- Ausgezeichnete Schulungsinstrumente: Bei UNITED MACHINING bieten wir Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für alle. Wir bieten globale Lerntools sowie Schulungen und spezialisierte Kurse.
- Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit und Innovation: Wir haben hohe Nachhaltigkeits- und Innovationsziele. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam auf eine nachhaltige Zukunft hinarbeiten.
## Über United Machining
UNITED MACHINING ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Komplettlösungen für Hersteller von Präzisionskomponenten und Werkzeugen sowie für den Formenbau. Das Portfolio umfasst Maschinen für das Fräsen, die Funkenerosion, die Laserstrukturierung, die Lasermikrobearbeitung und die additive Fertigung. Darüber hinaus bietet der Geschäftsbereich Spindeln, Automatisierungslösungen, Werkzeuge und digitalisierte Lösungen, die durch einen unübertroffenen Kundenservice und Support unterstützt werden.
Zu UNITED MACHINING gehören die Marken AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, , STEP TEC und SYSTEM 3R.
UNITED MACHINING hat seinen Hauptsitz in Biel, Schweiz, und beschäftigt derzeit über 3'000 Mitarbeitende an mehr als 50 Standorten weltweit.
